episodes.187539: A strong front brough widespread rain to Northwest California and damaging winds to portions of Del Norte and Humboldt counties. Small stream flooding was common across the region while main stem rivers also flooded in Mendocino County.
episodes.187602: Remnants of a cold front and light steering winds generated slow-moving showers around Toa Baja and its vicinity, which led to flooding in Levitown late in the night. Also, a funnel cloud developed earlier in the day in Culebra.

events.narrative: Emergency managers reported several impassable roads in the 3rd section of Levittown, including Paseo Conde, Paseo Criolla, and Paseo Criolla.
Offramp of Highway 101 and adjacent streets closed due to flooding at Hookton Slough.
Highway 36 closed due to flooding from nearby creeks.
Highway 211 fully closed by flooding from nearby creeks.
